name: breakout-room
title: Breakout Room
description: Breakouts for a live room: the host splits the room into groups with a timer, sends one message to every group, and calls everyone back; each phone shows its group, who is in it, the time left and the latest message. The rules are `games/breakout-model`…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/breakout-room

Installed to `components/ui/games/breakout-room.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/breakout-room';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/breakout-room

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
